i1.title: Rue Broca Penthouse Larvotto Eau de Parfum 80ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Riviera glamour: bergamot and violet leaf over warm vanilla and amber.

Rue Broca Penthouse Larvotto Eau de Parfum 80ml is inspired by the penthouses above Monaco's Larvotto beach. Fresh bergamot, violet leaf and coriander open, a heart of rose and black pepper adds a spicy edge, and it settles into a warm, powdery base of vanilla, patchouli and amber.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Bergamot, Violet Leaf, Coriander
  • Heart: Rose, Black Pepper
  • Base: Vanilla, Patchouli, Amber

Key details

  • Brand: Rue Broca
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 80ml
  • Scent profile: Aromatic · Spicy · Amber
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A fresh bergamot and violet leaf opening
  • A spicy rose and black pepper heart
  • A warm vanilla, patchouli and amber base
  • Great value for a long-wearing Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Penthouse Larvotto smell like?

Bergamot, violet leaf and coriander first, then rose and black pepper, finishing with vanilla, patchouli and amber.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.
